Ramification, genus and 496 rational-point totals cross-check.

value.rationale: The complete orbit decomposition of all 496 rational points and the exact four quotient values are natural and useful arithmetic invariants for a newly constructed exceptional maximal curve. The distinction between a rational 48-point branch orbit and a geometrically isomorphic degree-two branch orbit is invisible from branch indices and genus; this can inform automorphism-equivariant divisors and rational-place coding constructions without assuming downstream theorems.
